test.create_query: CREATE TABLE enum16_dense ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() AS SELECT CAST(intHash32(number) % 2000, assumeNotNull((SELECT 'Enum16(' || arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> '''ProfileEvent_SomeMetricName' || toString(i) || ''' = ' || toString(i), range(2000)), ', ') || ')'))) AS e FROM numbers(20000000)
test.query: SELECT CAST(e AS String) FROM enum16_dense FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT CAST(toInt16(e), toTypeName(e)) FROM enum16_dense FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
